text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service fastpath-ingest -> routed to team 'infra-night' (rule: fastpath-default). PD incident: PD-4728. No ack yet.
erica: seeing pings from PagerDuty... is infra-night our rotation for fastpath-ingest? not matching the new rotation we rolled out today.
kevin: @erica yeah that should have gone to 'ingest-platform' group. I just deployed a rollout that changed default-service tag, suspicion is rule matched old fallback.
pagerbot: PagerDuty alert posted: "high error rate - fastpath ingestion" - link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-4728 :exclamation:
matt: acking PD-4728, jumping on it. :raised_hand:
oncall-night: acked (oncall-night). I'm seeing the page on PD but this is definitely not our service. Paging was to night rota.
sara: can we confirm customer impact? any 5xx spikes in metrics?
erica: dashboards show a spike at 02:12 UTC - ~150 errors/min for fastpath-ingest. Affected customers in eu-west, ~2% of requests failing. throwing 502 from downstream redis cluster.
kevin: re-checking PD routing rules: the fastpath rule has two matches, one uses tag "service:fastpath-ingest" and fallback uses "default-service:infra-night". Our rollout updated fastpath tag to "service:fastpath-ingest-v2" but didn't update the PD matchers.
erica: summary: misconfigured matcher -> fallback -> wrong oncall paged -> slower response time. oof.
matt: mitigation: re-run pageroute to route PD-4728 to 'ingest-platform' manually. @kevin can you run the PD reassign CLI?
kevin: running:
```
pdctl incidents reassign PD-4728 --to-service ingest-platform --note "misroute fix"
```
kevin: done. PD shows reassigned -> new oncall 'ingest-platform' notified. :white_check_mark:
oncall-night: thanks, handed back. I'll unack now to clear noise.
oncall-night: unacked (clearing) :wave:
ingest-platform: Acked PD-4728. Investigating the 502s.
erica: running quick rollback on the redis proxy config to stop 502s. patch applied at 02:25 UTC.
ingest-platform: errors dropped to baseline within 70s after rollback. customer impact reduced. continuing postmortem.
matt: can we add a temporary PD rule to prefer service tag variant v2? Or better, use exact match instead of fallback.
kevin: good call. I'm going to push a hotfix to PD rules: change matcher to include both tag variants and add explicit deny rule for infra-night default.
kevin: hotfix snippet:
```
matcher:
  - tag == "service:fastpath-ingest-v2"
  - tag == "service:fastpath-ingest"
fallback: null
```
erica: also adding an alert suppression window for infra-night to avoid further noise while we patch.
incident-bot: Incident PD-4728 - service reassigned to ingest-platform, mitigation applied, customer errors decreased. Status: monitoring.
matt: post-incident actions:
- PD rules: consolidate tag matching (assigned to kevin)
- infra-night runbook: document when fallback allowed (assigned to sara)
- add unit test to deployment pipeline to verify PD tags (assigned to erica)
kevin: ETA for PD rule tests + hotfix deploy: 2 hours.
sara: will draft a short customer-facing note for affected tenants, keeping it factual, no outage wording.
ingest-platform: follow-up: root cause is mismatch between deploy tag naming and PD matcher. Will add pre-deploy hook to validate.
erica: thanks all. quick retro: better to avoid silent tag renames in deploys. cc @oncall-rotation for longer term scheduling of simulated misroute drills.
oncall-rotation: noted. We'll add scenario to quarterly oncall drills.
incident-bot: Thread closed for now. If any regressions, reopen with PD incident id.
